title: Great AI. Missing context.
narration: Your AI can write code. But does it have the right context? When every task starts with another tour of your repository, the real work has to wait.

title: Give your AI a map.
narration: Meet CodeAtlas. An open source AI context engine that turns your TypeScript and JavaScript project into a reusable, searchable map.

title: From files to relationships.
narration: Scan the source. Connect symbols and dependencies. Keep the index on your machine. When code changes, update the map instead of starting from scratch.

title: Find the code that matters.
narration: Search for a symbol. Inspect its source. Build a focused context package for the task, with an explicit token budget. Give your tools evidence they can work with.

title: Your workflow. More context.
narration: Export context for your coding tools, or connect through MCP. Here is a real OpenCode response on a small authentication example. CodeAtlas prepares the context. Your agent does the reasoning.

title: Bring a repeatable workflow.
narration: Go beyond one prompt. Thirteen built in Skills bring reusable instructions for debugging, research, and development. Discover optional tools, then choose what to install.

title: Built in the open.
narration: Local indexing. Deterministic search. Optional AI enrichment. The audited build passes thirteen hundred and ninety four tests. Explore the developer preview, and help shape what comes next.

title: Give your AI the bigger picture.
narration: CodeAtlas. Map your project. Focus your context. Build with evidence. Explore the repository on GitHub, try the developer preview, and join the project.
